description: The case the flag exists for: the spouse's $200,000 of box-1 wages exceed the $176,100 wage base, but they are the SPOUSE's — the SE earner's own social security wages are an explicit $0, so OASDI applies to the full 46,175 of net earnings: line 10 $5,726 + line 11 $1,339 = $7,065. Falling back to the couple's wages would have wiped the OASDI (line 8a 200,000 > 176,100) and produced $1,339.
